description: This file defines an abstract class 'LifecycleSubject' that manages lifecycle observation, subscription, and execution of lifecycle start and stop phases with logging and error handling.

classes.name: LifecycleSubject
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle stages and observers, supporting start and stop operations with logging, error handling, and subscription management.

classes.name: LifecycleSubject.OrderedObserver
classes.description: Represents an observer's participation in a specific lifecycle stage, holds the observer reference and stage number.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the lifecycle, invoking 'OnStart' on all subscribed observers in order of their stages.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the lifecycle, invoking 'OnStop' on all observers in reverse order of their stages.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to a specific lifecycle stage, returns a disposable to manage subscription lifetime.

methods.name: GetStageName
methods.description: Returns the string name for a given stage number.

methods.name: GetStageNames
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary mapping stage numbers to their string names based on reflected static fields.

methods.name: PerfMeasureOnStart
methods.description: Logs performance metrics for the start operation of a stage.

methods.name: PerfMeasureOnStop
methods.description: Logs performance metrics for the stop operation of a stage.

methods.name: CallOnStart
methods.description: Invokes 'OnStart' on an observer with error handling.

methods.name: CallObserverStopAsync
methods.description: Invokes 'OnStop' on an observer with error handling.

methods.name: OnStartStageCompleted
methods.description: Hook invoked when a start stage completes.

methods.name: OnStopStageCompleted
methods.description: Hook invoked when a stop stage completes.
